w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They argued over names for 6 beasts — 6 words, 6 debates: "The Ugly Beast" (2), "Headlight Harry" (2), "Big Loud" (2), "Old Gavel" (2), "Big-Eyes" (2), "Ugly-Eyes" (2).

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Focus Group: Be boring — bore them out of the room. The murmur loves violence one round and is bored by it the next. Be deliberately boring for three rounds — recite bus schedules, count ceiling tiles — and they lose interest and LEAVE. (Striking is entertainment; every swing is a review.) (Caleb lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Timeslot, Big Ugly, The Terms of Service, Big Big) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Buffering mauled Ruby (-88 health) over 11 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Editor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Raul opens the pantry wide: 6× Foraged food, 2× Expedition haul, 1× Foraged food. Gonzalo, Raj, Ursula, Ruby eat until the fire burns low. The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. For one evening, grief sits at the fire with them instead of standing ove
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.
It followed you. The Big Ugly is here.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to ruin.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Brian freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Picked clean. The houses fed someone — not you.

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
firstContext: You work the patch with practiced hands: 4× Sassafras (80 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to grove.
Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
👁️ Ursula freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Brian: "Smell that? Something's different here."

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: (−40 kcal — food becomes keepsake.)
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Ursula freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
🚪 BARRIER CROSSED — you crash through to a new area. The pursuit falters behind you — they give up the chase. (You fled the fight by leaving the area.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Caleb again, quieter: "Three weeks we've known them. Feels longer."
Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: Recipe: Snare (Level 1). You have seen a snare. A loop, a stick, an animal.
Watching the Snare do its work, you finally see the shape of it — the loop, the trigger, the patience. You could build one now.

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 89 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 28 → 24 · capped · Craft 10 · Talk 13 · Explore 30 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ruby Callaghan ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,357 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
